text:
Plant 7 night patrol checklist (B. Alonso, informal)

Before 22:00
[ ] Check dock status light and battery on the app
[ ] Confirm weather is inside limits
[ ] Patrol route A (perimeter fence) and route B (loading yard) scheduled

During the night
[ ] Alert arrives on manager phone -> look at the clip within 5 minutes
[ ] If real: call the guard desk directly (contractor does not watch drone alerts)
[ ] Log the alert in the sheet: time, route, outcome

Morning
[ ] Export last night's flights
[ ] Note any missed patrols and why

Two attempted break-ins deterred so far this year (see sheet). Not shared with head office.
